Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，The location phrase must come before the action verb in this verb phrase. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，装作 means “pretend to do something”; it must be followed by the action being imitated. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other possible main character has intervened, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at age five, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”之前。
“装祭拜”搭配不完整，改为“装作祭拜”可以表示假装进行祭拜。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按近距离复现规则应使用“他”。
五岁时搬家是一次完成的过去事件，应用“搬了家”。
